messages:
fix: reject unregistered sequence commands and expose unsupported commands

Causal account 3b38384b3: sequence-registered-command-rejection. Preserve all 81 Java factory registrations, their order, Pattern2/FoxSignature language and multiline boundaries. Dispatch recognized commands only to their mapped Rust handlers; report unsupported classes/variants explicitly. No global dispatch or other-family edits. Parent-approved T14.21/T14.22 upstream exceptions remain in maker evidence.

fix: propagate sequence command color execution failures

Causal account 3b38384b3: sequence-command-color-execution. Validate the selected ColorParser leaf and HColorSet command fields, including PART2 boundary fallback and arrow style colors. Preserve valid color syntax and explicitly report incomplete composite/gradient paint support.

fix: validate gradient endpoints as Java simple colors

Causal account 3b38384b3: sequence-command-color-execution. HColorSet.parseColor delegates gradient endpoints to parseSimpleColor; transparent, background and automatic are HColor symbols, not XColor endpoints.

fix: consume complete sequence footbox visibility commands

Causal accounts 3b38384b3: sequence-footbox-command-consumption and sequence-resume-citation-correction. Match Pattern2 optional whitespace before permissive Rust message parsing, and correct the current CommandAutonumberResume method citation without rewriting history.

fix: serialize sequence SVG attributes with ASCII XML references

Causal account 3b38384b3: sequence-local-attribute-serialization. Follow pinned SvgGraphics us-ascii JAXP attribute serialization for whitespace and Unicode scalars. Keep existing text-node consumers separate; no shared SVG imports.

Causal accounts 3b38384b3: sequence-footbox-command-consumption and sequence-resume-citation-correction. Match Pattern2 optional whitespace before permissive Rust message parsing, and correct the current CommandAutonumberResume method citation without rewriting history.

fix: enforce Java ordinary-arrow UTF-16 admission limit

Causal account 8efd66082. CommandArrow alone applies RegexConcat.protectSize(2000); enforce it after Java command trimming and before pattern matching. Count UTF-16 units rather than UTF-8 bytes or Unicode scalar count.

Revert "fix: enforce Java ordinary-arrow UTF-16 admission limit"

This reverts commit ba3d0196bcb11829a3e114871976faaa695c7025.

grouping_rewrite: Only row 56 rewrites syntax: Java negative fixed lookbehinds exclude immediate #color after else/also/end; Rust uses a disjoint alternation for those three keywords. Both retain the separate spaced second color. Fresh group-primary/secondary and alt nesting test this.
